terra.problem: The description of a cherub as a mix of creatures is too broad: the sources give that description for Ezekiel’s visions, not every cherub. ‘Mercy seat’ may also be unfamiliar to a 10-year-old. Explain it simply and note that ‘cherubim’ means more than one cherub.
